cat > /app/recover.py <<'EOF'
import json, struct

PAGE = 4096
data = open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()

def varint(b, o):
    v = 0
    for i in range(9):
        c = b[o+i]
        if i == 8:
            v = (v<<8)|c; return v, o+9
        v = (v<<7)|(c & 0x7f)
        if not (c & 0x80):
            return v, o+i+1

def sval(b, o, t):
    if t == 0: return None, o
    if t in (1,2,3,4,6): 
        n = {1:1,2:2,3:3,4:4,6:8}[t]
        v = int.from_bytes(b[o:o+n],'big',signed=True); return v, o+n
    if t == 5:
        v = int.from_bytes(b[o:o+6],'big',signed=True); return v, o+6
    if t == 7: return struct.unpack('>d', b[o:o+8])[0], o+8
    if t == 8: return 0, o
    if t == 9: return 1, o
    n = (t-12)//2
    if t % 2 == 0: return b[o:o+n], o+n
    return b[o:o+n].decode('utf-8','replace'), o+n

rows = []
for pno in range(len(data)//PAGE):
    p = data[pno*PAGE:(pno+1)*PAGE]
    off = 100 if pno == 0 else 0
    if p[off] != 0x0d:      # only table b-tree leaf pages hold rows
        continue
    ncell = int.from_bytes(p[off+3:off+5],'big')
    ptrs = [int.from_bytes(p[off+8+2*i:off+10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]
    for cp in ptrs:
        if cp < off or cp >= PAGE: continue
        try:
            plen, o = varint(p, cp)
            rowid, o = varint(p, o)
            start = o
            hlen, o2 = varint(p, o)
            types = []
            while o2 < start + hlen:
                t, o2 = varint(p, o2)
                types.append(t)
            vals = []
            for t in types:
                v, o2 = sval(p, o2, t)
                vals.append(v)
            rows.append((rowid, vals))
        except Exception:
            continue

out = []
for rowid, vals in sorted(rows):
    word = next((v for v in vals if isinstance(v, str)), None)
    value = next((v for v in vals if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)), None)
    if word is None: continue
    out.append({"word": word, "value": value})

json.dump(out, open('/app/recover.json','w'), indent=2)
print(len(out), out)
EOF

EOF
